page_title: MNT 0-0 REI | Montpellier v Reims 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Keito Nakamura (Reims) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+2' Keito Nakamura (Reims) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Reims.

90+1' Two players stand over the free kick. Keito Nakamura (Reims) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall. Reims force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' A yellow card is awarded to Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier).

90' Keito Nakamura (Reims) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Benjamin Lecomte anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
86' Sergio Akieme (Reims) launches a cross from the corner, but Benjamin Lecomte is alert to thwart the effort.
86' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Keito Nakamura (Reims), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Reims are going to take it.
85' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
84' Reims are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Ferri trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joris Chotard (Montpellier).
74' Zoumana Camara has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Teji Savanier (Montpellier) replacing Khalil Fayad.
72' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) sends it out of play.

72' The referee points to the corner flag and Montpellier will take a corner. Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
69' Gabriel Moscardo (Reims) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amadou Kone.
69' Zoumana Camara prepares a substitution. Junior Ndiaye is replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
68' Sergio Akieme (Reims) picks up a yellow card.
68' Here's the change. Joseph Okumu leaves the pitch and Sekine Hiroki (Reims) comes on as a substitute.
64' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

62' Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the left side of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf made a crucial save!
61' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for an infringement.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) is coming onto the pitch as Jordan Siebatcheu cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
56' Reims take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
55' The corner kick from Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
53' Keito Nakamura (Reims) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
52' Joseph Okumu (Reims) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jeremie Pignard blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
50' Montpellier keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
46' Half-time substitution. Wilfried Ndollo Bille (Montpellier) will not participate anymore and Falaye Sacko is coming on.
46' Samba Diawara makes a half-time substitution. Nhoa Sangui comes on in place of Cedric Kipre (Reims).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' The ball falls kindly for Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post.
45+1' Cedric Kipre (Reims) has tested the patience of referee Jeremie Pignard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Yael Mouanga (Montpellier) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.

40' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Yehvann Diouf has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Samba Diawara is forced to make a change. Junya Ito is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
32' Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game. One of the players from Reims won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
27' Keito Nakamura (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' A player from Reims commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
24' Reims quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
23' Sergio Akieme (Reims) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Benjamin Lecomte intercepts the ball.
19' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 63:37.
18' The Montpellier players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
12' Montpellier have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
12' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) serves up a nice cross, but Yehvann Diouf punches the ball away.
11' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
8' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) works the corner short.
8' Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Montpellier are awarded a corner kick.
7' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
4' Keito Nakamura (Reims) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Benjamin Lecomte.
4' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
2' Keito Nakamura (Reims) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' The first half has just begun.
Reims will kick the game off.
